species.name: Cicak Terbang
species.summary: Gekko kuhli, commonly known as Kuhl's flying gecko or the common flying gecko, is a species of lizard in the family Gekkonidae. The species is endemic to Asia.
Ular-kukri cokelat (Oligodon purpurascens) adalah spesies ular kukri yang terdapat di daerah tropis Asia Tenggara.
Aphaniotis acutirostris, barancik moncong-panjang, adalah spesies bunglon dalam famili Agamidae . Spesies ini endemik di Indonesia ....

species.name: Anjing Domestik
species.summary: Anjing domestik atau anjing (Canis familiaris atau Canis lupus familiaris) adalah hewan mamalia yang telah mengalami domestikasi dari serigala sejak 15.000 tahun yang lalu, bahkan kemungkinan sudah sejak 100.000 tahun yang lalu berdasarkan bukti genetik berupa penemuan fosil dan tes DNA.

species.name: Katak-Pohon Mutiara
species.summary: Nyctixalus pictus, or the cinnamon frog, is a species of frog in the Rhacophoridae family.

species.name: Prok-bruk Loncos
species.summary: Rhinolophus acuminatus (acuminate horseshoe bat) atau prok-bruk lonkos adalah sebuah spesies kelelawar dalam keluarga Rhinolophidae. Spesies tersebut ditemukan di Brunei, Kamboja, Indonesia, Laos, Malaysia, Filipina, dan Thailand. Spesies tersebut tinggal di hutan dan kawasan perkotaan.

species.name: Labi-labi Hutan
species.summary: The Malayan softshell turtle (Dogania subplana) is a species of softshell turtle in the family Trionychidae. It is monotypic in its genus.

Sphyraena putnamae, the sawtooth, chevron or military barracuda, is a species of barracuda found in all tropical seas and temperate waters of major oceans with the exception of the eastern pacific. It is found near shores in bays, turbid lagoons, and some reefs.
Gekko albomaculatus, commonly known as Smith's gecko or large forest gecko, is a species of gecko. It is found in Thailand and Malaysia.

Katak pohon berjumbai (Kurixalus chaseni) adalah sejenis katak anggota suku Rhacophoridae. Katak ini menyebar di Semenanjung Malaya hingga wilayah yang berbatasan di Thailand; Pulau Sumatra, serta Borneo. Dalam bahasa Inggris katak ini dikenal sebagai Frilled Tree Frog, atau Malay Frilled Treefrog.

species.name: Celepuk enggano
species.summary: The Enggano scops owl (Otus enganensis) is an owl endemic to Enggano Island, Indonesia.

Holothuria leucospilota, commonly known as the black sea cucumber/ Black tarzan, is a species of marine invertebrate in the family Holothuriidae. It has been placed in the subgenus Mertensiothuria making its full scientific name Holothuria (Mertensiothuria) leucospilota.

species.name: Katak Gembong
species.summary: Katak gembong (Limnonectes blythii) adalah jenis katak yang ukurannya sangat besar, yakni panjang 20 cm, dan lebar 12 cm. Oleh sebab itu, terkadang katak gembong ambigu dengan katak besar yang berasal dari familia Ranidae.
Polypedates pseudotilophus is a species of frogs in the family Rhacophoridae. It is endemic to Sumatra and Java in Indonesia.

Phrynoidis juxtasper, also known as the giant river toad or Borneo river toad, is a species of toad in the family Bufonidae. It is found in Borneo (Brunei, Indonesia, and Malaysia) and Sumatra (Indonesia) below 1,600 m (5,200 ft) asl.

species.name: Cica daun sayap-biru sumatera
species.summary: Cica daun sayap biru sumatera (Chloropsis moluccensis) adalah spesies burung yang habitat hidupnya berada di wilayah Kalimantan Timur hingga Sumatera Selatan.
Boiga nigriceps (black-headed cat snake) is a species of colubrid snake from South-East Asia. They are large snakes; adults may attain a total length of 1.75 m (5 1⁄2 ft).
Lutjanus vitta, commonly known as the brownstripe red snapper, is a marine fish native to the western Pacific and Indian Oceans.

species.name: Katak Jeram Kerinci
species.summary: Sumaterana crassiovis is a species of true frog. It is endemic to Sumatra, Indonesia. It is also known as the Bander Baru frog, Korinchi frog, and Kerinci cascade frog.
Trimeresurus hageni is a venomous pit viper species endemic to Southeast Asia. No subspecies are currently recognized.
Selar tengkek atau selar tetengkek (Megalaspis cordyla) adalah sejenis ikan yang hidup di perairan pantai sampai kedalaman 80 m, termasuk ke dalam suku Carangidae.

species.name: Kupu-kupu raja brooke
species.summary: Rajah Brooke's birdwing (Trogonoptera brookiana) is a birdwing butterfly from the rainforests of the Thai-Malay Peninsula, Borneo, Natuna, Sumatra, and various small islands west of Sumatra (Banyak, Simeulue, Batu and Mentawai).
Draco haematopogon, the red-bearded flying dragon or yellow-bearded gliding lizard, is a species of agamid lizard. It is found in Indonesia and Malaysia.
Draco melanopogon, commonly known as the black-bearded gliding lizard, is a species of agamid "flying lizard" endemic to Southeast Asia.

The Black-spotted Sticky Frog (Kalophrynus pleurostigma) is a small frog with a black spot just in front of each of its hind legs. It releases a sticky substance when threatened, thereby making it an unpleasant meal for predators, allowing it to escape from harm.
Calamaria schlegeli adalah spesies ular dalam famili Colubridae . Spesies ini dikenal secara umum sebagai surapari cabai dan surapari kepala-merah.

Ular-terbang merah atau yang juga disebut ular-pohon belang atau ular-terbang belang adalah spesies ular pohon dari suku Colubridae. Ular ini terdapat di Asia Tenggara, dan seperti jenis ular terbang lainnya, ular ini dapat berpindah dari pohon ke pohon dengan melayang di udara.

species.name: Landak Malaya
species.summary: Landak raya atau landak malaya (Hystrix brachyura) adalah sebuah spesies hewan pengerat dalam famili Hystricidae. Tiga subspesies dapat ditemukan di Asia Tenggara dan Selatan.

Katak-terbang wallace atau katak-terbang sungai abah (Rhacophorus nigropalmatus) adalah katak berwarna hijau dan emas cerah yang dapat melompat dari dahan ke dahan dengan menggunakan selaput ekstralebar di sela-sela jari kaki dan “sayap” dari kulit di bagian sisi.
Cephalopholis formosa or Blue line grouper is a grouper from the Indo-West Pacific that occasionally makes its way into the aquarium trade. It grows to a size of 34 cm in length.

species.name: Kerapu lumpur
species.summary: The Malabar grouper or greasy grouper, Epinephelus malabaricus, is a species of marine fish in the family Serranidae.

The giant catfish (Netuma thalassina), also known as the giant sea catfish, giant salmon catfish, giant marine-catfish, or the khagga, is a species of catfish in the family Ariidae. It was described by Eduard Rüppell in 1837, originally under the genus Bagrus.

species.name: Musang Bulan
species.summary: The masked palm civet or gem-faced civet (Paguma larvata) is a civet species native to the Indian Subcontinent and Southeast Asia.

species.name: Ular Buta Bergaris
species.summary: Ramphotyphlops lineatus atau ular kawat bergaris lurus adalah sejenis ular kawat dari suku Typhlopidae.
Rhabdophis rhodomelas, the blueneck keelback or blue-necked keelback, is a species of snake in the subfamily Natricinae of the family Colubridae.
The woolly horseshoe bat (Rhinolophus luctus) is a species of bat in the family Rhinolophidae.

images.credit: The Darwin Initiative Centre for Bat Research

species.summary: Hylarana rufipes is a species of true frog in the genus Hylarana. It is found in Padang, West Sumatra, Indonesia, though it probably has a wider distribution. It was split off from Hylarana chalconota in 2009 by Robert Inger and colleagues, along with a number of other species.
Draco fimbriatus, the fringed flying dragon or crested gliding lizard, is a species of agamid lizard. It is found in Malaysia, Indonesia, the Philippines, and Thailand.
Papilio helenus, the red Helen, is a large swallowtail butterfly found in forests of southern India and parts of Southeast Asia.
Swinhoe's white-eye (Zosterops simplex) is a bird species in the family Zosteropidae. It is found in east China, north Vietnam, the Thai-Malay Peninsula, Sumatra and Borneo.

species.name: Ekek layongan
species.summary: Ekek layongan (Cissa chinensis) adalah salah satu bagian dari keluarga gagak, tetapi kira-kira kurang lebih agak kecil sedikit dibandingkan dengan Ongklet erasia.Persebaran mereka di Tiongkok,Malaysia, dan Sumatra.Makanannya, katak, kadal, dan ular.
Known as Taylor's bow-fingered gecko, four-striped forest gecko and marbled bent-toed gecko, Cyrtodactylus quadrivirgatus is a species of gecko found in Thailand, Malaysia, Singapore and Indonesia.
Johnius amblycephalus, the bearded croaker, is a marine fish native to the Indian and Pacific Oceans.
Limnonectes sisikdagu adalah spesies katak dari keluarga Dicroglossidae. Hewan ini adalah endemik Indonesia. Spesies katak ini endemik di Pulau Sumatra Indonesia.

Scolopsis japonica, the Javan monocle bream or whitecheek monocle bream, is a species of marine ray-finned fish belonging to the family Nemipteridae, the threadfin breams. This fish is found in the western Pacific Ocean.
Rasbora vulcanus is a species of ray-finned fish in the genus Rasbora native to Sumatra.

Gekko horsfieldii, also known commonly as Horsfield's flying gecko, Horsfield's gliding gecko, and Horsfield's parachute gecko, is a species of lizard in the family Gekkonidae. The species is endemic to Asia.
The dark wolf snake (Lycodon albofuscus) is species of snake in the family colubridae. It is found in Asia.
Draco quinquefasciatus, the five-lined flying dragon or five-banded gliding lizard, is a species of agamid lizard. It is found in Thailand, Indonesia, and Malaysia.

The spotted flagtail or dark-margined flagtail (Kuhlia marginata), is a species of flagtail native to fresh and brackish waters of islands of Southeast Asia and Oceania. It may also enter marine waters. It mostly occurs in sunny areas of rocky rivers at depths of from 1.5 to 3 m (4.9 to 9.8 ft).

The Malayan field rat, Malaysian field rat or Malaysian wood rat, (Rattus tiomanicus) is a species of rodent in the family Muridae. It is nocturnal and mainly arboreal and is found in Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia and the Philippines.

Rhacophorus catamitus is a species of frog in the family Rhacophoridae. It is endemic to Sumatra, Indonesia, and occurs in the Barisan Mountains at elevations of 1,068–1,680 m (3,504–5,512 ft) above sea level. Its natural habitats are tropical forests. Males call from low vegetation near streams.

species.name: Musang lingsang
species.summary: Musang congkok (nama ilmiah: Prionodon linsang) adalah salah satu spesies linsang, mamalia pemakan daging yang hidup di pohon di wilayah Sunda di Asia Tenggara. Hewan ini ditemukan di Myanmar selatan, Thailand, Semenanjung Malaysia, Kalimantan, Sumatra, Jawa, serta Kepulauan Bangka Belitung.

species.name: Pelanduk napu
species.summary: Pelanduk napu, atau lebih populer dengan sebutan napu atau napuh (Tragulus napu) adalah sejenis mamalia kecil yang tergolong ungulata berteracak genap. Termasuk ke dalam suku Tragulidae, hewan ini berkerabat dekat dengan pelanduk jawa dan pelanduk kancil.

species.name: Tupai Tanah
species.summary: The large treeshrew (Tupaia tana) is a treeshrew species within the Tupaiidae. It is native to Sumatra and adjacent small islands, as well as in the lowlands and hills of Borneo.

Zhangixalus achantharrhena is a species of frog in the family Rhacophoridae. It is endemic to Sumatra (Indonesia) and known from a number of high-elevation localities ranging from Aceh in the northwest to Lampung in the southeast.

species.name: Kongkang Jangkrik
species.summary: Kongkang jangkrik (Hylarana nicobariensis) adalah sejenis katak anggota suku Ranidae. Katak bertubuh kecil dan ramping ini menyebar di Asia Tenggara dan Indonesia bagian barat.
Draco modiglianii, the lined flying dragon, is a species of agamid lizard. It is found in Indonesia.
Draco obscurus, the dusky gliding lizard, is a species of agamid lizard. It is found in Indonesia and Thailand.
Harpesaurus brooksi is a species of lizard within the agamid family.

species.name: Musang Leher-Kuning
species.summary: Musang leher-kuning (Martes flavigula) atau amunin panan adalah sejenis karnivora dari genus Martes. Sebagai anggota suku Mustelidae, musang ini lebih dekat kekerabatannya dengan biul dan berang-berang ketimbang dengan golongan musang sejati (suku Viverridae).

species.name: Sepah Hutan
species.summary: Sepah hutan (bahasa Latin: Pericrocotus flammeus) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Campephagidae, dari genus Pericrocotus. Burung ini merupakan jenis burung pemakan ulat, jengkerik, kecoa, serangga lain yang memiliki habitat di hutan primer, dataran rendah, perbukitan. Tersebar sampai ketinggian 1.500 m dpl.

Rhacophorus barisani is a species of frog in the Rhacophoridae family endemic to Indonesia. Its natural habitats are subtropical or tropical moist montane forests, rivers, and freshwater marshes. It is threatened by habitat loss.

species.name: Capung Kipas Sayap Ragam
species.summary: Rhyothemis variegata, known as the common picture wing or variegated flutterer, is a species of dragonfly of the family Libellulidae, found in South Asia. It breeds in marshes, ponds and paddy fields. They appear to have weak flight and can easily be mistaken for butterflies.
Acentrogobius viridipunctatus, or the Spotted green goby, is a species of goby found in brackish and salt water in the lower Chao Phraya River.

Ingerophrynus claviger is a species of toad in the family Bufonidae. It is endemic to Indonesia where it is found on Sumatra and Nias island. It is a rare species found in lowland forests. It is threatened by habitat loss.

Also known as Banded Lipinia, Sipora Striped Skink or Common Striped Skink, Lipinia vittigera is a species of skink in the genus of Lipinia native to Myanmar, Thailand, Vietnam, Malaysia, Singapore and Cambodia.

The Indian scops owl (Otus bakkamoena) is a resident species of owl found in the southern regions of Asia from eastern Arabia through the Indian Subcontinent, except the far north, east across much of Southeast Asia to Indonesia.
Vinciguerra's lipinia (Lipinia relicta) is a species of skink found in Indonesia.
The black-and-crimson oriole (Oriolus consanguineus) is a species of bird in the family Oriolidae.
The black roughneck monitor lizard, Varanus rudicollis, is a species of monitor lizard found in Southeast Asian countries of Thailand, Burma, and Malaysia.
Dumeril's monitor (Varanus dumerilii ) is a species of lizard, endemic to Southeast Asia. It is a member of the family Varanidae.
Ular-kucing Bengkulu adalah sejenis ular kucing suku Colubridae yang endemik di Provinsi Bengkulu, Sumatra, Indonesia. Sejauh ini, belum ada cukup informasi mengenai spesies baru ini.
The sunburned rat (Rattus adustus) is a species of rat from Enggano Island in Indonesia. It is only known from the holotype and has not been recorded since its description in 1940.

species.name: Cikrak Muda
species.summary: The Sunda warbler (Phylloscopus grammiceps) is a species of Old World warbler in the Phylloscopidae (or Sylviidae) family. It is found only in Indonesia.

species.name: Kadalan Birah
species.summary: Kadalan birah (bahasa Latin = Phaenicophaeus curvirostris) adalah spesies burung dari keluarga Cuculidae, dari genus Phaenicophaeus. Burung ini merupakan jenis burung pemakan ulat bulu, semut, serangga besar, kepiting, kadal, anak burung yang memiliki habitat di hutan, semak belukar, padang ilalang.

species.name: Sepah hutan
species.summary: The scarlet minivet (Pericrocotus speciosus) is a small passerine bird. This minivet is found in tropical southern Asia from India to southern China, Indonesia, and the Philippines. They are common resident breeding birds in forests and other well-wooded habitats including gardens, especially in hilly country.
Hypolimnas bolina, the great eggfly, common eggfly or in New Zealand the blue moon butterfly is a species of nymphalid butterfly.
The plume-toed swiftlet (Collocalia affinis) is a small bird in the swift family Apodidae. It is found on some eastern Indian Ocean islands, the Malay Peninsula, Sumatra, and lowland Borneo.

species.name: Bekicot
species.summary: Bekicot atau Lissachatina fulica adalah siput darat yang tergolong dalam suku Achatinidae.

species.name: Cecak Kayu
species.summary: The common house gecko (Hemidactylus frenatus) (not to be confused with the Mediterranean species Hemidactylus turcicus known as Mediterranean house gecko), is a reptile native of Southeast Asia. It is also known as the Pacific house gecko, the Asian house gecko, house lizard, or Moon Lizard.

species.name: Tepus Emas
species.summary: The golden babbler (Cyanoderma chrysaeum) is a babbler species in the family Timaliidae. It occurs from the foothills of the Eastern Himalayas to Southeast Asia and inhabits subtropical lowland and montane forests. It is listed as Least Concern on the IUCN Red List because of its wide distribution.

species.name: Kupu kupu pastur
species.summary: Kupu-kupu pastur (Papilio memnon) adalah sejenis rama-rama dari suku Papilionidae (kupu-kupu ekor walet). Ia menyebar luas di Asia bagian selatan, mulai dari anak benua India, Asia Tenggara, hingga Jepang selatan.

species.name: Ciung-Air Coreng
species.summary: The pin-striped tit-babbler (Macronus gularis), also known as the yellow-breasted babbler, is a species of Old World babbler found in South and Southeast Asia.

Graphium agamemnon, the tailed jay, is a predominantly green and black tropical butterfly that belongs to the swallowtail family. The butterfly is also called the green-spotted triangle, tailed green jay, or green triangle.

species.name: Kupu-kupu jeruk
species.summary: Kupu-kupu jeruk (Papilio demoleus) adalah sejenis rama-rama dari famili Papilionidae. Dinamai demikian karena ulat kupu-kupu ini biasanya hidup dan menjadi hama di pohon jeruk.

Leptosia nina, the psyche, is a small butterfly of the family Pieridae (the sulphurs, yellows and whites) and is found in Southeast Asia and the Indian subcontinent. The upper forewing has a black spot on a mainly white background.
Junonia atlites, the gray pansy or grey pansy, is a species of nymphalid butterfly found in South Asia.
Appias libythea, the striped albatross, is a small butterfly of the family Pieridae, that is, the yellows and whites, which is found in India and Peninsular Malaysia.
Elymnias hypermnestra, atau Common Palmfly, sebuah spesies kupu-kupu yang termasuk dalam famili Nymphalidae dalam subfamili Satyrinae.

Catopsilia pomona, the common emigrant or lemon emigrant, is a medium-sized pierid butterfly found in Asia and parts of Australia. The species gets its name from its habit of migration. Some early authors considered them as two distinct species Catopsilia crocale and Catopsilia pomona.

species.name: Merbah Kacamata
species.summary: The spectacled bulbul (Pycnonotus erythropthalmos), also known as the lesser brown bulbul, is a member of the bulbul family of passerine birds. It is found on the Malay Peninsula, Sumatra, and Borneo. The spectacled bulbul was originally described in the genus Ixos.

species.name: Lebah Madu Timur
species.summary: Lebah madu Asia (Apis cerana), atau yang juga dikenal sebagai lebah madu Asiatik atau lebah madu timur, adalah sebuah spesies lebah madu yang berasal dari Asia Timur, Tenggara dan Selatan, dan keduanya berada pada subgenus yang sama dengan lebah madu barat (Eropa), Apis mellifera.

Semut geramang atau geramang (Anoplolepis gracilipes) adalah spesies semut yang pada awalnya diperkenalkan secara sengaja ke utara Australia dan Pulau Natal di Samudra Hindia. Semut ini telah mendatangkan kerusakan ekologis di kedua lokasi tersebut. Semut ini merupakan salah satu spesies invasif terbesar di dunia.

Neptis hylas, the common sailor, is a species of nymphalid butterfly found in the Indian subcontinent and South-East Asia. It has a characteristic stiff gliding flight achieved by short and shallow wingbeats just above the horizontal. For the other butterfly called the common sailor, see Neptis laeta.

species.name: Kadalan Kera
species.summary: The green-billed malkoha (Phaenicophaeus tristis) is a species of non-parasitic cuckoo found throughout Indian Subcontinent and Southeast Asia. The birds are waxy bluish black with a long graduated tail with white tips to the tail feathers. The bill is prominent and curved.
Junonia iphita, the chocolate pansy or chocolate soldier, is a butterfly found in Asia.

species.name: Kucing Domestik
species.summary: Kucing disebut juga kucing domestik atau kucing rumah (nama ilmiah: Felis silvestris catus atau Felis catus) adalah sejenis mamalia karnivora dari keluarga Felidae. Kata "kucing" biasanya merujuk kepada "kucing" yang telah dijinakkan, tetapi bisa juga merujuk kepada "kucing besar" seperti singa dan harimau.

Cosmophasis lami adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Salticidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Cosmophasis dan ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1997 oleh Berry, Beatty Prószynski.

species.name: Lalat Tentara Hitam
species.summary: Lalat tentara hitam (nama ilmiah: Hermetia illucens) adalah salah satu jenis lalat yang banyak ditemukan di tempat-tempat yang terdapat sampah organik. Lalat tentara hitam (Bahasa Inggris: Black Soldier Fly, disingkat BSF) adalah termasuk kedalam golongan ordo Diptera, family Stratiomyidae dengan genus Hermetia.
Euploea mulciber, the striped blue crow, is a butterfly found in India and Southeast Asia that belongs to the crows and tigers, that is, the danaid group of the brush-footed butterflies family.
Leucauge celebesiana, commonly called the black-striped orchard spider, is a species of spider belonging to the family Tetragnathidae. It is found from India to China, Japan, Sulawesi and New Guinea.
Hierodula patellifera, common name giant Asian mantis, Asian mantis or Indochina mantis, is a species of praying mantis belonging to genus Hierodula.

Aedes albopictus (Stegomyia albopicta), juga dikenal sebagai nyamuk macan Asia atau nyamuk hutan, adalah nyamuk asli daerah tropis dan subtropis di Asia Tenggara; namun, dalam beberapa dekade terakhir, spesies ini telah menyebar ke banyak negara melalui pengangkutan barang dan perjalanan internasional.

Argiope reinwardti adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Araneidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Argiope dan ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1859 oleh Doleschall.

Xylocopa latipes, the tropical carpenter bee, is a species of carpenter bee widely dispersed throughout Southeast Asia. As its name suggests, this bee inhabits forests in warm tropical climates and constructs nests by burrowing into wood.

Danaus genutia, the common tiger, is one of the common butterflies of India. It belongs to the "crows and tigers", that is, the Danainae group of the brush-footed butterflies family. The butterfly is also called striped tiger in India to differentiate it from the equally common plain tiger, Danaus chrysippus.

Vespa velutina, yang dikenal juga sebagai tawon berkaki kuning atau tawon predator asia, adalah spesies tawon yang berasal dari Asia Tenggara. Spesies ini menjadi perhatian karena sifatnya yang invasif di beberapa negara lain, terutama di sebagian besar wilayah Eropa. V.
Cricula trifenestrata, the cricula silkmoth, is a moth of the family Saturniidae. It is found from India to the Philippines, Sulawesi, Java, and Sri Lanka.

species.name: Cucak Bersisik
species.summary: The scaly-breasted bulbul (Pycnonotus squamatus) is a species of songbird in the bulbul family. It is found from the Malay Peninsula to Borneo. Its natural habitat is subtropical or tropical moist lowland forests. It is threatened by habitat loss.
Delias hyparete, the painted Jezebel, is a medium-sized butterfly of the family Pieridae, found in South Asia and Southeast Asia.

images.credit: Alan Kwok (King Lun), Ada Tai (Ah Heung) / 阿達蘭 AdAlan

species.summary: Graphium doson, the common jay, is a black, tropical papilionid (swallowtail) butterfly with pale blue semi-transparent central wing bands that are formed by large spots. There is a marginal series of smaller spots. The underside of wings is brown with markings similar to upperside but whitish in colour.

Theretra oldenlandiae, the impatiens hawkmoth or taro hornworm, is a member of the family Sphingidae found in India, Sri Lanka, China, Borneo, Japan, the Philippines, Thailand, and Australia. It was described by Johan Christian Fabricius in 1775.
Hypolimnas anomala, the Malayan eggfly or crow eggfly (Chinese: 畸紋紫斑蛺蝶) is a species of eggfly.
The palm weevil Rhynchophorus vulneratus is one of two species of snout beetle known as the red palm weevil or Asian palm weevil.
Appias lyncida, the chocolate albatross, is a butterfly of the family Pieridae, that is, the yellows and whites, which is found in South and South East Asia.

species.name: Penggulung Daun Pisang
species.summary: Erionota thrax yang umumnya diketahui dengan nama ulat penggulung daun pisang adalah termasuk anggota kupu-kupu yang terdapat dalam familia Hesperiidae. Ia ditemukan dari India, Asia Tenggara hingga Papua New Guinea. Lalu, ke arah China Selatan.

species.name: Kangkok Besar
species.summary: Kangkok besar (Hierococcyx sparverioides) adalah spesies pada familia tekukur, kangkok, dan sejenisnya yaitu cuculidae.
The Grass Demon Udaspes folus is a small but prominent butterfly found in India that belongs to the Skippers, or Hesperiidae family. It is regarded as an occasional pest of ginger and turmeric.

Vespa tropica, the greater banded hornet, is a tropical species of hornet found in Southern Asia, new Guinea and west Africa, and which has recently been discovered to be an invasive species on the Pacific Island of Guam. It is a predator of paper wasps.
Penthicodes farinosus is a species of planthoppers in the subfamily Aphaeninae (Fulgoridae): with five subspecies distributed in Indo-China and Malesia.
Delias belisama is a butterfly in the family Pieridae. It was described by Pieter Cramer in 1779. It is found in the Indomalayan realm.
Nyctemera baulus is a moth of the family Erebidae. It is found from India to Samoa. Records include Queensland, Indonesia and New Guinea.
Delta pyriforme is a species of potter wasp in the subfamily Eumeninae of the family Vespidae.

Aedes aegypti merupakan jenis nyamuk yang dapat membawa virus dengue penyebab penyakit demam berdarah. Selain dengue, A. aegypti juga merupakan pembawa virus demam kuning (yellow fever), chikungunya, dan demam Zika yang disebabkan oleh virus Zika.
Papilio aegeus, the orchard swallowtail butterfly or large citrus butterfly is a species of butterfly from the family Papilionidae, that is found in eastern Australia and Papua New Guinea.

Plexippus paykulli adalah spesies laba-laba yang tergolong famili Salticidae. Spesies ini juga merupakan bagian dari genus Plexippus dan ordo Araneae. Nama ilmiah dari spesies ini pertama kali diterbitkan pada tahun 1826 oleh Audouin.

Tagiades japetus, commonly known as the pied flat or the common snow flat, is a species of spread-winged skipper butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae. It is widely distributed, being found from India, the Himalayas, Southeast Asia, to Australia. It contains twenty-four recognized subspecies.

Polyura athamas, the common nawab, is a species of fast-flying canopy butterfly found in tropical Asia. It belongs to the Charaxinae (rajahs and nawabs) in the brush-footed butterfly family (Nymphalidae).

Synapta maculata, the snake sea cucumber, is a species of sea cucumber in the family Synaptidae. It is found in shallow waters in the tropical Indo-Pacific Ocean. Sometimes growing as long as 3 m (10 ft), it is one of the longest sea cucumbers in the world.
Thorelliola ensifera is a species of jumping spider of the genus Thorelliola. Originally native to Southeast Asia, it has been widely introduced to tropical islands across the Pacific Ocean.
Papilio ascalaphus, the Ascalaphus swallowtail, is a butterfly of the family Papilionidae. It is found in Indonesia and the Philippines.
Catopsilia pyranthe, the mottled emigrant, is a medium-sized butterfly of the family Pieridae found in South Asia, Southeast Asia, and parts of Australia.
Ophiocoma scolopendrina is a species of brittle star belonging to the family Ophiocomidae.

Barbatia amygdalumtostum, the almond ark or burnt-almond ark, is a species of bearded ark clams in the Barbatia genus discovered by Röding in 1798. Barbatia amygdalumtostum lives in ocean environments.
Pantoporia hordonia merupakan spesies kupu-kupu dari famili Nymphalidae yang tersebar di wilayah tropis dan subtropis Asia, termasuk Kamboja.
Parantica aspasia, the yellow glassy tiger, is a butterfly found in Asia that belongs to the crows and tigers, that is, the danaid group of the brush-footed butterflies family.
Coenobita violascens is a species of land hermit crab native to the Indonesia, Nicobar Islands, Thailand, Cambodia, Philippines, and Tanzania.
Hidari irava, the coconut skipper, is a butterfly of the Hesperiidae family. It is found in southern Myanmar, Thailand, western Malaysia, as well as on Sumatra, Java, Borneo and the Sula Islands.
Odontoptilum angulata, the chestnut angle or banded angle, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae and is found in Asia.
Cepora judith is a butterfly of the family Pieridae. It has no common name, although a subspecies is referred to as the orange gull. It is found in south-eastern Asia (see subspecies section).
Mauritia arabica, common name the Arabian cowry, is a species of cowry, a sea snail, a marine gastropod mollusk in the family Cypraeidae, the cowries.
Heterometrus longimanus, the Black Emperor Scorpion or Asian forest scorpion, is a species of scorpions belonging to the family Scorpionidae.
Pseudoxya diminuta is an Asian species of grasshopper.
Rhinopalpa polynice, the wizard, is a nymphalid butterfly found in India and South Asia, and is the only species in the genus Rhinopalpa.

Symbrenthia lilaea, the common jester, is a species of nymphalid butterfly found in South Asia and Southeast Asia. It forms a superspecies with Symbrenthia hippoclus and there are numerous regional forms and the taxonomy of the group is not well resolved.

Danaus melanippus, the black veined tiger, white tiger, common tiger, or eastern common tiger, is a butterfly species found in tropical Asia which belongs to the "crows and tigers", that is, the danaine group of the brush-footed butterflies family.
Scolopendra subspinipes (Vietnamese Centipede) is a species of centipede. The native range is uncertain. The certain natural range is Meganesia and Indomalaya.

species.summary: Dundubia vaginata is the type species in its genus, sometimes called the jade-green cicada (Hemiptera: Cicadidae) in the tribe Dundubiini.

Pareronia valeria, the common wanderer or Malayan wanderer, is a medium-sized butterfly of the family Pieridae, that is, the yellows and whites, and is found in India and Southeast Asia. The butterfly found in India is sometimes considered as a separate species, Pareronia hippia.
Chalcosoma caucasus (Caucasus beetle) (Thai : ด้วงกวางเขาสามจันทร์) is a species of beetle in the Scarabaeidae family. This species is a senior synonym of Chalcosoma chiron and Chalcosoma janssensi.
Notocrypta paralysos, the banded demon or common banded demon, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae.
Appias albina, the common albatross, is a small butterfly of the family Pieridae. It is found in India, Southeast Asia and Australia.
Papilio nephelus is a species of swallowtail butterfly belonging to the family Papilionidae. Subspecies include P. n. chaon, the yellow Helen, and P. n. sunatus, the black and white Helen.
Amphidromus palaceus is a species of air-breathing land snail, a terrestrial pulmonate gastropod mollusc in the family Camaenidae.
Ancistroides nigrita, the chocolate demon, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae.
Idea stolli, the common tree nymph, is a species of nymphalid butterfly in the Danainae subfamily. It is found in South East Asia. There are twelve Idea species, of which five occur in West Malaysia.

Kupu-kupu sayap oranye atau Appias nero (Inggris: Orange Albatross) adalah salah satu spesies kupu-kupu dari keluarga Pieridae. Spesies ini bisa ditemukan dari daerah India Utara, kepulauan Sunda, Filipina, dan Sulawesi.

Euploea tulliolus, the dwarf crow or small brown crow, is a butterfly found in the Solomon Islands, Malaysia, Taiwan, Vietnam, Singapore and Australia, that belongs to the crows and tigers, that is, the danaid group of the brush-footed butterflies family. Graphium evemon, the blue jay, lesser jay, or pale green triangle is a species of tropical butterfly found in India, Indonesia, and Malaysia.
Vindula erota, the common cruiser, is a species of nymphalid butterfly found in forested areas of tropical South Asia and Southeast Asia.

Austruca perplexa is a species of fiddler crab. It is found from the Ryukyu Islands, Japan to India, throughout the Malay Archipelago, along eastern Australian coasts from Queensland to New South Wales, and in various Pacific islands, including Fiji, Tonga and Vanuatu.
Cepora nerissa, the common gull, is a small to medium-sized butterfly of the family Pieridae, that is, the yellows and whites, which is native to India, China, Southeast Asia, and Indonesia.
Cethosia hypsea, the Malay lacewing, is a butterfly of the family Nymphalidae. It is found in from Burma to Indonesia and the Philippines.
Psolos fuligo, the coon, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae. The tips of the forewings diverge outward and is a feature that is clear when they rest on vegetation.
Papilio polytes, the common Mormon, is a common species of swallowtail butterfly widely distributed across Asia.
Daphnusa ocellaris is a species of moth of the family Sphingidae.

Gelasimus vocans is a species of fiddler crab. It is found across the Indo-Pacific from the Red Sea, Zanzibar and Madagascar to Indonesia and the central Pacific Ocean. It lives in burrows up to 50 centimetres (20 in) deep. Several forms of G.
Libythea myrrha, the club beak, is a butterfly found in India that belongs to the Libytheinae group of the brush-footed butterflies family.
Eurema sari, the chocolate grass yellow, is a butterfly in the family Pieridae. It is found in Southeast Asia.
Austruca annulipes is a species of fiddler crab found along the coastline from South Africa to Somalia, Madagascar, India, China, Indonesia, Malaysia, and the Philippines.
Psilogramma sundana is a moth of the family Sphingidae. It is known from the Sunda Islands in Indonesia.
Gandaca harina, the tree yellow, is a butterfly in the family Pieridae. It is found in India, Thailand, Cambodia, Myanmar, Malaysia, Singapore, Philippines, and Indonesia.

species.name: Rajungan Bintang
species.summary: The three-spot swimming crab (Portunus sanguinolentus), also known as the blood-spotted swimming crab or red-spotted swimming crab, is a large crab found throughout estuaries of the Indian and West Pacific Oceanic countries.
Ocypode cordimanus is a species of crab in the family Ocypodidae, sometimes called the smooth-handed ghost crab. It is widely distributed in the Indian Ocean and Pacific Ocean.
Papilio paris, the Paris peacock, is a species of swallowtail butterfly found in the Indian subcontinent and Southeast Asia.
Penthicodes atomaria is a species of lantern flies belonging to the family Fulgoridae.

Scylla serrata atau yang juga dikenal sebagai kepiting-bakau besar (giant mangrove crab, giant mud crab) adalah sejenis kepiting bakau yang menyebar luas mulai dari pantai-pantai Asia Timur, Tenggara, Selatan, hingga ke Laut Merah. Spesies ini tidak didapati di perairan Dangkalan Sunda....

species.summary: Rajungan karang (Charybdis feriata) adalah sejenis rajungan yang cukup banyak dikonsumsi, anggota suku Portunidae. Rajungan ini terutama menyebar di perairan tropis dan ugahari Indo-Pasifik Barat hingga Jepang dan Australia, serta Atlantik.

Hasora taminatus, the white banded awl, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae, which is found in Asia.

species.name: Rajungan Biasa
species.summary: Rajungan biasa, rajungan bunga, atau rajungan biru (Portunus pelagicus) adalah sejenis kepiting yang hidup di laut. Jenis ini biasanya ditemukan di wilayah pantai yang dangkal, terutama di perairan Samudra Pasifik bagian barat.
Neritina turrita is a species of aquatic snail, a gastropod mollusk in the family Neritidae.

Celaenorrhinus ficulnea, the velvet flat, is a species of butterfly in the family Hesperiidae. It is found in south-east Asia. The typical form exhibits the white central spot of the forewing above and beneath straightly cut off by the lower median branch. In some taxonomic schemes (e.g.
Gangara thyrsis, commonly known as the giant redeye, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae. It breeds on a number of palm species.
Hestina nama, the Circe, is a species of nymphalid butterfly found in South Asia.
Ideopsis gaura, the smaller wood nymph, is a species of nymphalid butterfly in the Danainae subfamily. It is found in Southeast Asia.
Euploea camaralzeman is an Indomalayan species of danaine butterfly.
Graphium bathycles, the veined jay, is a butterfly in the family Papilionidae, that is found in the Indomalayan realm.
Milionia basalis is a moth of the Geometridae family. It is found in Japan, the north-eastern parts of the Himalaya, Burma and Sundaland.
Tagiades gana, the immaculate snow flat, large snow flat or suffused snow flat, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae.

Tubuca coarctata is a species of fiddler crab found in the western Pacific ocean, including Japan, Taiwan, the Philippines, Indonesia, New Guinea and Australia (in Queensland and the Northern Territory).
Astictopterus jama, the forest hopper or the coon, is a butterfly in the Hesperiidae family. It is found in Asia.

Idea leuconoe, the paper kite, rice paper or large tree nymph, is known especially for its presence in butterfly houses and live butterfly expositions. It has a wingspan of 12 to 14 cm. The paper kite is of Southeast Asian origin, but can also be found in Northern Australia and Southern Taiwan.

Lamproptera curius, the white dragontail, is a species of swallowtail butterfly native to parts of South Asia and Southeast Asia. It belongs to the dragontails genus, Lamproptera, of the swallowtail (Papilionidae) family. It is not rare.

This species has a wide range being found in Southeast Asia including Indonesia, Malaysia and the Philippine Islands among other places.

Saletara liberia is a butterfly of the family Pieridae. It is found in Indonesia, the Philippines, Peninsular Malaysia and various islands in the region. Subspecies S. l. distanti is known by the common name Malaysian albatross.

Acrida cinerea, the Chinese grasshopper, is a member of the Acrididae family. Like other members of the genus Acrida, Acrida cinerea lacks stridulatory organs on its legs and so they do not make noise whilst moving.

Barbodes sellifer, the saddled barb, is a species of cyprinid fish described in 2021. This species has not been reported sold in the aquarium trade, but where the species is present reports of them being kept by aquarists are abundant.
Hasora schoenherr, commonly known as the yellow banded awl, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae which is found in India and Southeast Asia.

Iambrix stellifer, the starry bob or Malay chestnut bob, is a butterfly of the Hesperiidae family. It is found in southern Burma, Laos, Thailand, Malaysia and Singapore, as well as on Borneo, Sumatra, Nias, Java, Batoe and Mentawi. The habitat consists of forested lowland areas.

Lethocerus indicus is a giant water bug in the family Belostomatidae, native to South and Southeast Asia, as well as southeast China, Korea, the Ryukyu Islands and New Guinea. It was originally described as Belostoma indicum but is no longer placed in that genus.
Mooreana trichoneura, the yellow flat, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae and subfamily Pyrginae (flats). It has a wingspan of 32–36 mm.
Odontolabis dalmani is a species of beetles belonging to the family Lucanidae.

Scylla tranquebarica atau yang juga dikenal sebagai kepiting-bakau ungu (purple mangrove crab, purple mud crab) adalah sejenis kepiting bakau yang sering didapati dijual di pasar-pasar Asia Tenggara, terutama di Kepulauan Sunda.

Charybdis hellerii, the Indo-Pacific swimming crab or spiny hands is a species of crab from the swimming crab family, the Portunidae. Its native range covers the Indian and Pacific Oceans but it has been introduced to the western Atlantic and has invaded the Mediterranean.
Hyarotis adrastus, the tree flitter, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae.
Idea lynceus, the tree-nymph, is a species of nymphalid butterfly in the Danainae subfamily. It is found in South East Asia.
Appias indra, the plain puffin, is a small butterfly of the family Pieridae, that is, the yellows and whites, which is found in India and Southeast Asia.

Archigenes aita is a butterfly in the family Riodinidae. It is found on both Sumatra and Borneo. It was first described by British entomologist Lionel de Nicéville in 1893. A phylogenetic analysis led to its being moved out of the genus Abisara.
Clanis stenosema is a species of moth of the family Sphingidae first described by Rothschild and Jordan in 1907. It is known from Nias, Sumatra, Java, Borneo and the Philippines.
Pelates quadrilineatus, also known as Trumpeter perch or fourlined terapon, is a fish species.

species.summary: Appias cardena, the yellow puffin, is a butterfly in the family Pieridae. It was described by William Chapman Hewitson in 1861. It is found in the Indomalayan realm.
Lethe mekara, the common red forester, is a species of Satyrinae butterfly found in India and Southeast Asia.
Odontolabis castelnaudi is a beetle of the family Lucanidae.

Pithauria marsena, the banded straw ace, is a butterfly in the Hesperiidae family. It is found from Sikkim to Burma and in Thailand, Laos, northern Vietnam, China, Malaysia, as well as on Borneo, Sumatra, Nias, Natuna, Java and Bali.
Thereuopoda longicornis, also known as the long-legged centipede, is a species of centipede in the Scutigeridae family. It was first described in 1793 by Danish zoologist Johan Christian Fabricius.
Amphidromus enganoensis is a species of air-breathing land snail, a terrestrial pulmonate gastropod mollusc in the family Camaenidae....
Cepora nadina, the lesser gull, is a small to medium-sized butterfly of the family Pieridae, that is, the yellows and whites, which is native to India, Myanmar, Hainan, and Southeast Asia.

Euploea alcathoe, commonly known as the no-brand crow, Eichhorn's crow or striped black crow, is a common butterfly found from India to Borneo, and in the Moluccas, New Guinea and Australia. It belongs to the crows and tigers subfamily of the Nymphalidae (brushfooted butterflies).
Nacaduba hermus, the pale four-line blue, is a species of lycaenid butterfly found in Indomalayan realm. The species was first described by Baron Cajetan von Felder in 1860.

Saletara liberia is a butterfly of the family Pieridae. It is found in Indonesia, the Philippines, Peninsular Malaysia and various islands in the region. Subspecies S. l. distanti is known by the common name Malaysian albatross.

Ashtoret lunaris, the yellow moon crab, spotted moon crab or box crab, is an Indo-Pacific species of carnivorous crab which is a member of the family Matutidae. It has been recorded in the eastern Mediterranean since 2010, probably reaching that sea through the Suez Canal from the Red Sea by Lessepsian migration.
Elymnias ceryx is a butterfly in the family Nymphalidae. It was described by Jean Baptiste Boisduval in 1836. It is found in the Indomalayan realm.
Gonocephalus pyrius, the angle-headed dragon, is a species of agamid lizard. It is found in Sumatra.
Hasora vitta, the plain banded awl, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae which is found in India and parts of Southeast Asia.
Jamides parasaturatus is a butterfly of the family Lycaenidae. It is found in Sumatra and Peninsular Malaysia.
Lebeda cognata is a moth of the family Lasiocampidae. It is found on Borneo, Peninsular Malaysia and Sumatra.

Notocrypta curvifascia, the restricted demon, is a butterfly belonging to the family Hesperiidae. N. curvifascia is commonly found in many regions of temperate and tropical East Asia, Indonesia, and the Indian subcontinent, wherever its preferred larval host plant, Alpinia nutans can be found.
Philautus ventrimaculatus is a frog in the family Rhacophoridae. It is endemic to Indonesia, in Sumatra. It has been observed between 1838 and 2446 meters above sea level.

Arhopala pseudomuta, Raffles's oakblue is a species of butterfly belonging to the lycaenid family. It was described by Otto Staudinger in 1889. Kunugia latipennis, the pine lappet moth, is a moth of the family Lasiocampidae. The species was first described by Francis Walker in 1855.
Mansonia (Mansonioides) uniformis is a species of zoophilic mosquito belonging to the genus Mansonia.
Megophrys lancip, the pointed horned frog, is a species of frog from the Megophrys genus. It is endemic to Indonesia. The species was scientifically described in 2018.
Meretrix meretrix, commonly known as the Asiatic hard clam, is a species of saltwater bivalve in the family Veneridae.
Pachygrapsus minutus is a species of small shore crabs in the family Grapsidae.

Rhagastis rubetra is a moth of the family Sphingidae. It is known from Indonesia (Kalimantan, Nias, Sumatra) north through Malaysia (Sarawak, Peninsular) to Thailand and possibly southern Tibet, China.
